title: Trading Volume Manipulation and Competition Among Centralized Crypto Exchanges
authors: Dan Amiram; Evgeny Lyandres; Daniel Rabetti
eligible_reason: No staggered TWFE design. The two DiDs are validation tests around single events: Table 4 (China's 2017 ban on domestic crypto exchanges; BAN x POST) and Table 5 (a CoinMarketCap liquidity-index introduction; TREAT x POST). Both are plain lm() regressions of manipulation measures on the interaction plus time-varying exchange controls (KYC, AML, log EX_LISTED, EX_AGE, TRAFFIC, Tweets, Commits, ICO, FX_AGE_ANY) and quote-currency dummies, without exchange or calendar-time FE, and each has one event date. The main Tables 6-9 are pooled OLS of manipulation measures on competition measures (log FX_LISTED_LAG etc.) with region dummies and controls.
design_notes: Exchange-pair-time data on centralized crypto exchanges (DATA.RData, MS_DATA.RData); PC2B1, EDM2.V, MAD.V = volume-manipulation proxies (Benford, distribution tests). CHINA_BAN_A/B.RData and CMC_A/B.RData are event samples; standard errors clustered by trading PAIR (lm.cluster). EX_DATA.RData exchange-level aggregates for Tables 8-9.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Each DiD is around one event date (China exchange ban; CMC liquidity-index launch). Event timing taken from code comments; package RData files were not opened.

specs.exclusion_reason: single event date; no unit or time FE; time-varying controls

specs.notes: EDM2.V and MAD.V outcomes at lines 310, 314.
